published.source: Report re-sim on master 5bbcb0d, 2026-10-16: Grace of Air with Windfury in the melee raid, Windfury Totem main hand only, off-hand Rage 0.5 and channel pushback on hits taken (was 713.7)

summary: Shred and Rip cat with Berserk on cooldown and no Rake. Under Forever the cat swings at 1.0s with its weapon's DPS, and stones, potions, Thistle Tea and Windfury Totem work in Cat Form.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form (no Stealth/Prowl or Ravage)
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown; Berserk with the on-use trinket
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 CP and Rip has 6s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2s
Rip at 4+ combo points when it is down (not in the last 8s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6s or more left (or in the last 8s)
caveats: Rip's level 31+ client ranks are 6-9% below Era. Era values would add 1.6%.
Howling Idol (0.5s off Shifting Power since client 1.60.1.70425) is worth 4.8 at 180s; 5-piece Grovekeeper Ferocity would add 5.9 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, AP on Rip and Ferocious Bite, Rend and Tear's scope
Keeping Rake up costs 33 DPS. Rip at 5 CP ties.
One +2% crit elixir. Grizzly instead of Ferocity would add 4.9.
Tiger's Fury is gone in Forever. It was worth 24.9.
Cat swing damage spreads 20% either side (the server's range is unknown).
Windfury Totem and a second shaman's Grace of Air in the melee group. Dense Weightstone adds 4.9. Elemental Sharpening Stone is left out (Molten Core plans).
notes: Request from mksettings -spec feral (melee group: Strength of Earth and Windfury Totem, all blessings, own Leader of the Pack; latency 100 ms). Duration 180s, durationVariation 20. Forever lets the cat drink in form, so Mighty Rage Potion and Thistle Tea are used. No edits needed.
